about: The backend for MyFin, a personal finance and budgeting app.

prs.title: Expenses late on the last day of a month now count in the budget
prs.broken: The Essential total stopped at the very start of the last day of the month, so an expense dated later that day was missed.
prs.changed: The range now runs to the end of that day.
prs.matters: Budget totals match what was actually spent.

prs.title: Transactions late on December 31 now count in that year
prs.broken: Yearly amounts by category, entity and tag stopped at the start of December 31, leaving out anything dated later that day.
prs.changed: All three now run to the end of the day.
prs.matters: Year-by-year reports no longer come up short.
